title: Welcome Lakshmi
line: For abundance, gratitude and a sense of enough.
intro: Lakshmi is abundance in every sense: wealth, beauty, grace, the feeling that there is enough. She is welcomed where there is gratitude and care for what one already has.
offering: A lamp, a lotus, a clean and welcoming space.

steps.title: Arrive
steps.text: Sit comfortably, with your back upright and soft. Follow the circle: in as it grows, out as it settles. Never strain.

steps.title: Light the lamp
steps.text: Light a lamp for her; Lakshmi is welcomed with light.

steps.title: Salute her
steps.text: The opening verse of the Mahalakshmi Ashtakam.

steps.title: What is already here
steps.prompt: What three things do I already have, that I am grateful for?

steps.title: Close
steps.text: Read the closing prayer once, slowly. Then sit for one more breath before you return to your day.

after: Fridays and Diwali are especially hers.
